status: Reader-facing synthesis of recorded measurements and a proposed allocation; not new games or prospective validation

sampling.units: relative match Elo, not absolute human rating
sampling.note: Separate comparisons with distinct sample sizes; intervals are marginal bootstrap 95% intervals. App-rule sensitivities support the same broad findings. Gains are not additive.

roster.status: Proposed allocation, not measured future bot counts or activated roster
roster.collection: Read the visible cumulative chart tooltips on the official public page; values rounded by that page. No raw histogram was downloaded.
roster.method: Subtract adjacent cumulative shares; normalize by 99.2% after excluding below 600; allocate 10,000 with largest remainders at a 10-identity resolution. The top open-ended share is assigned to the proposed 2600–3000 catalog band. This is a planning cap, not a measurement of the above-3000 share. Rapid requires a separate distribution.
